subject: PBI
body: Power BI models work best with which schema?
options: Star schema (fact tables linked to dimension tables)
explanation: It is simpler and faster.

subject: PBI
body: A fact table usually contains
options: numeric measurements of events, such as sales amounts
descriptive attributes like product names only
explanation: Dimension tables describe the facts.

subject: PBI
body: The most common relationship cardinality between a dimension and a fact table is
explanation: The dimension is on the 'one' side.

subject: PBI
body: A date table should be marked as a date table to
explanation: It needs a continuous column of unique dates.

subject: PBI
body: What is the difference between a measure and a calculated column?
options: Measures are stored in the table
Calculated columns respond to slicers instantly without storage
A measure is calculated at query time in the filter context; a calculated column is stored row by row
explanation: Prefer measures for aggregations.

subject: PBI
body: Which DAX function changes the filter context of a calculation?
explanation: For example CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Amount]), Region[Name] = "North").

subject: PBI
body: Which DAX function returns a value from the 'one' side of a relationship into the 'many' side?
explanation: RELATEDTABLE goes the other way.

subject: PBI
body: SUMX differs from SUM because SUMX
options: evaluates an expression row by row and then adds the results
explanation: It is an iterator.

subject: PBI
body: ALL() in DAX is used to
options: remove filters from a table or column
explanation: Useful for percentage-of-total calculations.

subject: PBI
body: Power Query transformations are written in which language?
explanation: The Advanced Editor shows the M code.

subject: PBI
body: Turning many monthly columns into rows of month and value is
explanation: Unpivot creates a tidy, long table.

subject: PBI
body: Combining two tables with the same columns, one under the other, is
explanation: Merge joins tables side by side on a key.

subject: PBI
body: Import mode differs from DirectQuery because Import
options: queries the source live every time
loads a copy of the data into the model for fast queries
explanation: DirectQuery sends queries to the source live.

subject: PBI
body: To refresh data from an on-premises SQL Server in the Power BI service, you need
explanation: The gateway connects the cloud service to local data.

subject: PBI
body: Row-level security (RLS) is used to
options: restrict which rows of data each user can see
explanation: Roles use DAX filter expressions.

subject: PBI
body: A Power BI app is used to
options: distribute a packaged set of reports and dashboards to many users
explanation: Apps are published from workspaces.

subject: PBI
body: Which visual best shows a trend over time?
explanation: Use bar or column charts for comparing categories.

subject: PBI
body: The PL-300 exam leads to which certification?
options: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
explanation: The passing score is 700.

subject: PBI
body: Which DAX function divides safely and returns BLANK (or an alternate result) when the denominator is zero?
explanation: DIVIDE(numerator, denominator, alternate) avoids errors.

subject: PBI
body: Which function lets a measure ignore filters on one column but keep all other filters?
explanation: Useful for share-of-total calculations.

subject: PBI
body: Which function returns the value of a column when exactly one value is selected?
explanation: It returns BLANK (or an alternate) when there are several.

subject: PBI
body: Which time intelligence function calculates a year-to-date total?
explanation: It needs a proper date table.

subject: PBI
body: Which function shifts dates to compare with the same period last year?
explanation: Often used for year-on-year growth.

subject: PBI
body: Variables in DAX are declared with
explanation: Variables make measures faster and easier to read.

subject: PBI
body: What is 'context transition'?
options: When CALCULATE turns the current row context into a filter context
Moving a visual to another page
explanation: It happens when a measure is used inside an iterator or calculated column.

subject: PBI
body: Cross-filter direction 'Both' on a relationship means
options: filters flow in both directions between the tables
only one table can be filtered
explanation: Use it carefully; it can cause ambiguity.

subject: PBI
body: An inactive relationship can be used in a measure with
explanation: Common for multiple date columns (order date, ship date).

subject: PBI
body: A role-playing dimension is
options: one dimension table used for several relationships, such as Date for order date and ship date
explanation: Only one of the relationships can be active.

subject: PBI
body: Why should you avoid many high-cardinality calculated columns?
options: They can't be used in visuals
They increase model size and memory use
explanation: Prefer measures or Power Query columns where possible.

subject: PBI
body: In Power Query, 'Merge queries' is used to
options: join two tables on matching key columns
explanation: Join kinds include left outer, inner and full outer.

subject: PBI
body: Query folding means
options: Power Query steps are translated into the data source's own query language
explanation: Folding improves refresh performance.

subject: PBI
body: Which Power Query feature creates a profile of column values, errors and empties?
options: Column quality and column distribution (data profiling)
explanation: Found on the View tab.

subject: PBI
body: Drillthrough lets users
options: right-click a data point to open a detail page filtered to it
explanation: Set drillthrough fields on the target page.

subject: PBI
body: Bookmarks are used to
options: save a report state, such as filters and visible visuals
explanation: Often used with buttons for navigation.

subject: PBI
body: Which visual shows how a value changes from a start to an end value through positive and negative steps?
explanation: Good for profit bridges.

subject: PBI
body: Scheduled refresh in the Power BI service is configured on the
explanation: Pro licences allow up to 8 refreshes a day.

subject: PBI
body: Which workspace role can publish content but not manage access?
explanation: Admins manage access; Members can share; Viewers can only view.

subject: PBI
body: A dashboard in the Power BI service is
options: a single canvas of pinned tiles from one or more reports
the same as a multi-page report
explanation: Dashboards are only in the service, not Desktop.

subject: PBI
body: Which tool records how long each visual's DAX query takes?
explanation: Use it to find slow visuals.

subject: PBI
body: Static RLS differs from dynamic RLS because dynamic RLS
options: filters data using the signed-in user, such as USERPRINCIPALNAME()
uses fixed values for every role
explanation: One dynamic role can serve many users.
